cancellation.network_cancellation: Cancelling HTTPX tasks closes actual client sockets
cancellation.backend_caveat: Fixture jobs intentionally ignore disconnects and remain active until released. Gateway capacity limits admitted operations, not abandoned remote computation.
cancellation.resource_scope: Gateway RSS/fd samples at start and after each idle recovery; not peak RSS

timeout.deadline_scope: Cooperative upstream deadline; cleanup/scheduling can extend elapsed time

limitations: One process-local gateway, one event loop; no distributed correctness claim.
Driver and server processes share hardware; this is correctness evidence, not RPS.
Brief RSS/fd samples and finite cycles cannot prove absence of long-term leaks.
Fixture ignores socket disconnects; gateway cancellation cannot stop remote work.
